title: Zainab Ko Qaid Qaane Me Jab Hind ne Dekha
body:
Zainab ko qaid-e-Shaam me jab hind ne dekha
Boli yazeed tune sitam kaisa ye kardiya
Chudi badayi hathon ki chadar bhi phekdi
Bhikra ke sar ke baloun ko karne lagi buka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye dekhne se phele hi mai kyu na mar-gayi
Ro-ro ke binte zehra se ye hind ne kaha
Boli ye hind tham ke shahzadi ke qadam
Ye jaan meri tum pe fida binte Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaqa Hussain-o- ghazi alamdar hai kahan
Shehzadi jald mujko ye batlai-ye zara
Hamdard meri tham jigar sun mera bayan
Javed roke hind se boli ye sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ne qaid-e-Shaam me jab hind ko dekha
Aankhon se khoon bahake ye dene lagi sada
Aye hind kya batau ke mai dekti rahi
Karbobala me mera bhara ghar ujad gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Darya pe mere ghzai ke bazu huwe qalam
Pani ke sath sath lahu uska bhe-gaya
Naiza laga jo sene pe Akbar guzar gaya
Pamal ran me hogaya shabbar ka ladla
<<DIVIDER>>
Shash-maha par bhi aada ne kaise kiya sitam
Nanha sa halq ched ke qanjar chala diya
Lashoun pe lashe tanha uthate the shah-e-deen
Aaqa ko tere shimr ne phir zibha kar-diya
<<DIVIDER>>
Roti hai yaad karke Sakina jo baap ko
Rone se uske hota hai tukde jigar mera
Aye hind gham ye mujh ko har gham se hai siwa
Be-goro be-kafan mera majaya rhe-gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Javed ab likho ke wo hind kon thi
Zehra ki thi kanzze wo mohammed ne tha pala
